transformations.rationale: Adapted the Rust method signature to Verus named return syntax while preserving the generated `vec_into_iter_remaining` postcondition.
Modeled the source `self.len()` operand as a narrow iterator-state length boundary relating the returned length to the generated remaining-view helper.

Isolated only the Rust 1.96 raw immutable slice construction `slice::from_raw_parts(self.ptr.as_ptr(), self.len())` in a named external-body helper; the public target method remains executable and non-external-body.
